The AI lab was 6.37% down in premarket trading at 5:00am ET on Friday. Nvidia was down 2.67% and AMD fell 5.43%. Anthropic stock Anthropic soared 17% in its first day of trading on Thursday, after the company completed the biggest initial public offering on record, topping SpaceX' s historic debut in June. The stock closed at $97.17 per share. Investors had hoped that Anthropic's debut would revitalize the AI trade, which has come under pressure in recent months amid fears over capex spending. The sector has also had to contend with the fallout from Jensen Huang resigning as Nvidia CEO, alongside concerns that AI chip sales to Asia could slump as Washington cracks down on an export-control loophole. On Thursday, short seller Hunterbrook Media alleged in a report that firmware sold by chipmaker AMD had turned up in U.S.-blacklisted companies. AMD stock closed down more than 7%. The chipmaker told CNBC it complies with U.S. law. The sharp decline underscores growing investor concerns over SoftBank's aggressive bets on artificial intelligence, particularly its exposure to OpenAI, as markets question whether massive investments in AI infrastructure will generate sufficient returns. Elsewhere in the region, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co , or TSMC, closed 4.76% lower in Taiwan. As of the last hour of trading, Chinese tech giant Tencent was down 2.01%, while memory chipmaker CXMT fell 5.31% to a fresh record low, while Baidu dropped 4.79%.
